items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: A friend of mine said, Jack, he called me Jack, right on there, see?

ctx.x: So he came back and began to bulldoze.

And I used to sell Christmas trees. See, I'd sell somewhere around two or three thousand Christmas trees. And when everybody else was busted on Christmas day, I'm sitting there with eight or nine hundred dollars. See? I'd go out there, a lot of times I'd look and go out there in the freight yards. Sometimes a guy had a whole boxcar of Christmas trees. He's cold, you know? And they'd go in kind of slow and something like that. I bought a whole truck of trees and give a guy fifteen dollars. He wanted me to take…
How did you make out in the 50s with Natty Dominic and Baby and those guys?
